//: Canonical JSDoc + tsc type gate for the vanilla-web conventions (see SKILL.md). Copy into <app>/ next to the web root. `node tools/check.mjs` (or `npx tsc --noEmit`) is the whole gate — no emit, no build. Every .js and .mjs starts with // @ts-check; noUnusedLocals turns stale imports into hard errors. .test.mjs is excluded: those files pass deliberately wrong shapes to exercise edge cases, so tsc fights their purpose — check-syntax parses them instead.
